derivation: a primitive root (perhaps identical with H5377 (נָשָׁא), through the idea of imposition);
def: to lend on interest; by implication, to dun fordebt

occurrences.text: And every one that was in distress, and every one that was in debt, and every one that was discontented, gathered themselves unto him; and he became a captain over them: and there were with him about four hundred men.
Then I consulted with myself, and I rebuked the nobles, and the rulers, and said unto them, Ye exact usury, every one of his brother. And I set a great assembly against them.
The enemy shall not exact upon him; nor the son of wickedness afflict him.

source: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890) and Concise Dictionaries (1894), public domain; JSON by Open Scriptures (CC BY-SA).
